nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package initializer that appends every modules subpackage directory to sys.path so callers can use flat imports (e.g., `from sapmap_models import ...`) regardless of caller location.
nodes.languageNotes: Python package barrel using sys.path manipulation rather than re-exports — supports the project-wide flat-import convention.

nodes.name: sapmap.py
nodes.summary: Main CLI entry point for SAPMAP — parses arguments, launches the Bottle HTTP server, manages the pywebview GUI window (with GTK/macOS patches), and orchestrates state loading, scripted scenarios, and CLI-only scans.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses lazy imports for pywebview/GTK and threading.Thread for background Bottle server; includes a runtime monkey-patch for pywebview's evaluate_javascript signature mismatch on GTK.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Pytest configuration that registers every modules subpackage directory on sys.path, mirroring the production package initializer so tests can use flat imports.

nodes.name: capture_real_ticket.py
nodes.summary: Research utility that logs into a real SAP J2EE NetWeaver instance via HTTPS form authentication, captures the MYSAPSSO2 logon ticket, decodes/parses it, and compares against a forged ticket to validate the project's ticket-forging implementation.

nodes.name: compare_with_sap_ticket.py
nodes.summary: Diagnostic tool that reads an SAP-issued MYSAPSSO2 ticket via the Gateway SAPXPG channel and compares its structure (including PKCS#7 BER fields) against a locally forged ticket to validate forging fidelity.
nodes.languageNotes: Includes a hand-rolled BER tag-length parser and PKCS#7 SignedData walker — used to compare authentic SAP tickets against the project's forger output.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Argument-parsing and startup orchestrator: builds the SAPMAPApi state, optionally loads a prior session, starts the Bottle HTTP server thread, runs scripted scenarios, and either launches pywebview or opens the system browser.

nodes.name: _patch_pywebview_gtk
nodes.summary: Monkey-patches WebKit2.WebView.run_javascript and related GTK pywebview internals so newer WebKit2 versions (with run_javascript_finish signature changes) keep working with pywebview's JS evaluation.
nodes.languageNotes: Targets a known regression in pywebview's GTK backend against newer WebKit2 builds.

nodes.name: _try_pywebview
nodes.summary: Attempts to launch the GUI inside a pywebview window with platform-specific icon and process-name configuration (GTK GLib for Linux, AppKit NSImage for macOS); returns False to signal the caller should fall back to the system browser.

nodes.name: _cli_scan
nodes.summary: Headless CLI scan: parses target CIDR/host list, calls discover_systems, registers found nodes in state, prints a summary table, and auto-saves the resulting .sapmap session file.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Drives the end-to-end ticket capture flow: opens an HTTPS session, scrapes hidden form fields, submits credentials, parses the resulting Set-Cookie MYSAPSSO2 ticket, then forges an equivalent ticket locally and prints a field-by-field comparison.

nodes.name: _summarize_pkcs7
nodes.summary: Walks a PKCS#7 SignedData DER blob using a hand-rolled BER tag-length reader and prints content-type OIDs, digest algorithms, signer info, and signature fields for forensic comparison between SAP-issued and locally forged tickets.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements just enough BER parsing to navigate the PKCS#7 structure without pulling in cryptography/pyasn1 dependencies.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Reads an authentic MYSAPSSO2 ticket from disk on the target SAP host via Gateway SAPXPG-driven file read, parses it, then forges a local equivalent using the project's signing-key extraction and ticket-forge helpers and prints a field-level diff.
